records.source_text:
unfold fiberwiseClose at h_fw_dist_lt
  unfold hammingClose
  let d_fw := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β (i := i) steps h_i_add_steps f
  let C_i := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩
  let d_H := Code.distFromCode f C_i
  let d_i := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩
  let d_i_plus_steps := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩

  have h_d_i_gt_0 : d_i > 0 := by
    dsimp [d_i, BBF_CodeDistance]
    omega

  have h_C_i_nonempty : Nonempty C_i := by
    simp only [nonempty_subtype, C_i]
    exact Submodule.nonempty
      (BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i.val, by omega⟩)

  obtain ⟨g', h_g'_mem, h_g'_min_card⟩ : ∃ g' ∈ C_i, d_fw =
      (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g').ncard := by
    let S := (fun g : C_i =>
      (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) '' Set.univ
    have hS : S.Nonempty := Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty
    have hm : sInf S ∈ S := Nat.sInf_mem hS
    unfold d_fw at hm
    rw [Set.mem_image] at hm
    rcases hm with ⟨g, _, hg⟩
    exact ⟨g, g.property, hg.symm⟩

  have h_dist_le : (hammingDist f g' : ℕ∞) ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
    change (Δ₀(f, g') : ℕ∞) ≤ ↑d_fw * ((2 ^ steps : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
    rw [← ENat.coe_mul, ENat.coe_le_coe, h_g'_min_card]
    set ΔH := Finset.filter (fun x => f x ≠ g' x) Finset.univ
    have hdist : hammingDist f g' = ΔH.card := by
      simp only [hammingDist, ne_eq, ΔH]
    rw [hdist]
    set Y_bad := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g'
    simp only at *
    have hsub : ΔH ⊆ Finset.biUnion Y_bad.toFinset
        (fun y => ((qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
          (h_i_add_steps := by apply Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le; omega) (y := y)) ''
          (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (2 ^ steps)))).toFinset) := by
      intro x hx
      have hne : f x ≠ g' x := by simpa [ΔH] using hx
      let y := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
      apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
      refine ⟨y, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Set.mem_toFinset]
        change ∃ z, iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps
          h_i_add_steps z = y ∧ f z ≠ g' z
        exact ⟨x, rfl, hne⟩
      · simp only [coe_univ, Set.image_univ, Set.toFinset_range, mem_image,
          mem_univ, true_and]
        use pointToIterateQuotientIndex (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
          (h_i_add_steps := by omega) (x := x)
        exact (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps (by omega)
          (x := x) (y := y)).mp rfl
    apply (Finset.card_le_card hsub).trans
    rw [Finset.card_biUnion]
    · simp only [Set.toFinset_card]
      have hcard := card_qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β
        (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i steps h_i_add_steps
      simp only [Set.image_univ, Fintype.card_ofFinset, Subtype.forall] at hcard
      have hall : ∀ y ∈ Y_bad.toFinset,
          Fintype.card ((qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩)
            (steps := steps)
            (h_i_add_steps := by apply Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le; omega)
            (y := y)) '' ↑(Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (2 ^ steps)))) = 2 ^ steps := by
        intro y _
        have hy := hcard (a := y) (b := Submodule.coe_mem y)
        simpa only [coe_univ, Set.image_univ, Fintype.card_ofFinset] using hy
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hall]
      simp only [sum_const, Set.toFinset_card, smul_eq_mul, ofNat_pos, pow_pos,
        _root_.mul_le_mul_right, ge_iff_le]
      conv_rhs => rw [← _root_.Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
      simp only [card_eq_fintype_card, le_refl]
    · intro y₁ _ y₂ _ hy
      simpa only [Function.onFun, coe_univ] using
        (qMap_total_fiber_disjoint (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (β := β)
          (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩)
          (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := by omega) (hy_ne := hy))

  have h_dist_bridge : d_H ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
    apply le_trans (b := hammingDist f g')
    · simp only [distFromCode, SetLike.mem_coe, hammingDist, ne_eq, d_H]
      apply sInf_le
      exact ⟨g', h_g'_mem, le_rfl⟩
    · exact h_dist_le

  have h_fw_bound : 2 * d_fw ≤ d_i_plus_steps - 1 :=
    Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt)

  have h_identity : (d_i_plus_steps - 1) * 2 ^ steps = d_i - 1 := by
    dsimp [d_i, d_i_plus_steps, BBF_CodeDistance]
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ← Nat.pow_add, ← Nat.pow_add]
    have h1 : ℓ + 𝓡 - (i + steps) + steps = ℓ + 𝓡 - i := by
      rw [Nat.sub_add_eq_sub_sub_rev (h1 := by omega) (h2 := by omega),
        Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    have h2 : ℓ - (i + steps) + steps = ℓ - i := by
      rw [Nat.sub_add_eq_sub_sub_rev (h1 := by omega) (h2 := by omega),
        Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    rw [h1, h2]

  have h_dH_ne_top : d_H ≠ ⊤ := by
    simp only [ne_eq, d_H]
    rw [Code.distFromCode_eq_top_iff_empty f C_i]
    exact Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty'.mp h_C_i_nonempty

  let d_H_nat := ENat.toNat d_H
  have h_dH_eq : d_H = d_H_nat := (ENat.coe_toNat h_dH_ne_top).symm
  have h_final : 2 * d_H_nat ≤ d_i - 1 := by
    have h_bridge_nat : d_H_nat ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
      rw [← ENat.coe_le_coe]
      exact h_dH_eq.symm.le.trans h_dist_bridge
    calc
      2 * d_H_nat ≤ 2 * (d_fw * 2 ^ steps) := by gcongr
      _ = (2 * d_fw) * 2 ^ steps := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ ≤ (d_i_plus_steps - 1) * 2 ^ steps := by gcongr
      _ = d_i - 1 := h_identity

  simp only [d_H, d_H_nat] at h_dH_eq
  rw [h_dH_eq]
  change ((2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) * ↑Δ₀(f, C_i).toNat <
    ↑(BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  rw [← ENat.coe_mul, ENat.coe_lt_coe]
  exact Nat.lt_of_le_pred h_d_i_gt_0 h_final

have h_dist_le : (hammingDist f g' : ℕ∞) ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by

    rw [← ENat.coe_mul, ENat.coe_le_coe, h_g'_min_card]
    set ΔH := Finset.filter (fun x => f x ≠ g' x) Finset.univ
    have hdist : hammingDist f g' = ΔH.card := by
      simp only [hammingDist, ne_eq, ΔH]
    rw [hdist]
    set Y_bad := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g'
    simp only at *
    have hsub : ΔH ⊆ Finset.biUnion Y_bad.toFinset
        (fun y => ((qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
          (h_i_add_steps := by apply Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le; omega) (y := y)) ''
          (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (2 ^ steps)))).toFinset) := by
      intro x hx
      have hne : f x ≠ g' x := by simpa [ΔH] using hx
      let y := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
      apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
      refine ⟨y, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Set.mem_toFinset]
        change ∃ z, iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps
          h_i_add_steps z = y ∧ f z ≠ g' z
        exact ⟨x, rfl, hne⟩
      · simp only [coe_univ, Set.image_univ, Set.toFinset_range, mem_image,
          mem_univ, true_and]
        use pointToIterateQuotientIndex (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
          (h_i_add_steps := by omega) (x := x)
        exact (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps (by omega)
          (x := x) (y := y)).mp rfl
    apply (Finset.card_le_card hsub).trans
    rw [Finset.card_biUnion]
    · simp only [Set.toFinset_card]
      have hcard := card_qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β
        (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i steps h_i_add_steps
      simp only [Set.image_univ, Fintype.card_ofFinset, Subtype.forall] at hcard
      have hall : ∀ y ∈ Y_bad.toFinset,
          Fintype.card ((qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩)
            (steps := steps)
            (h_i_add_steps := by apply Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le; omega)
            (y := y)) '' ↑(Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (2 ^ steps)))) = 2 ^ steps := by

      simp only [sum_const, Set.toFinset_card, smul_eq_mul, ofNat_pos, pow_pos,
        _root_.mul_le_mul_right, ge_iff_le]
      conv_rhs => rw [← _root_.Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
      simp only [card_eq_fintype_card, le_refl]

      simpa only [Function.onFun, coe_univ] using

have hsub : ΔH ⊆ Finset.biUnion Y_bad.toFinset
        (fun y => ((qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
          (h_i_add_steps := by apply Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le; omega) (y := y)) ''

      intro x hx

      let y := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
      apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
      refine ⟨y, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Set.mem_toFinset]
        change ∃ z, iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps
          h_i_add_steps z = y ∧ f z ≠ g' z
        exact ⟨x, rfl, hne⟩
      · simp only [coe_univ, Set.image_univ, Set.toFinset_range, mem_image,
          mem_univ, true_and]
        use pointToIterateQuotientIndex (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
          (h_i_add_steps := by omega) (x := x)
        exact (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps (by omega)
          (x := x) (y := y)).mp rfl
